title: Agent block decision input (v0.5, D42)
description: Input of the agent-block vectors: one block write of the agent API after the gateway looked up its target (contract/agentapi CheckBlock, CheckLift; D42). op create: createAgentBlock; op lift: liftAgentBlock. address is the address the gateway recorded; it exists only inside the gateway and never in an agent's request or answer. Never sent anywhere.

writes_used.description: Writes of this token in the rolling hour.

running.description: Blocks set by agents that run now, whatever token set them.

mode.description: observe: the gateway runs the test profile, nothing is blocked (D89: there is no protection mode to set). autoblock: every other gateway.

exists.description: The named event, incident or pseudonym was found.

gone.description: The full address is no longer stored, or the evidence is older than 7 days.

attribution.description: As recorded. Anything but tcp_peer and trusted_proxy is refused.

own.description: On the allowlist, an address of the gateway host or in ingress.trusted_proxies.

released.description: An unblock exception of the operator runs for this client.

running.description: A block of this client key runs already.

status.description: Status of the incident; missing: no such number.

running.description: A timed block runs under this incident.
